title: 第二十五章 一匹黑马第二十六章 额外奖励
content_zh:
“现在时间还早，找个景区逛一下吧。”
离开安家天下门店之后，姜辰就对伍十一说道。
“姜总想去哪个景区？”伍十一一边发动汽车一边问道。
“随便。”
姜辰前世今生都没有来过燕京，虽然对燕京非常的好奇，但却不知道去什么地方玩。
伍十一开启导航，带着姜辰来到了附近的景区。
在景区逛了两个小时后，姜辰两人才回到了酒店。
“姜总，这是滴滴打车程总发来的文件，上面是后天参加融资的资本名单。”聂星辰将一份资料交给了姜辰。
“程总发来的？”
姜辰愣了愣，旋即笑了起来：“看来程总的打算很精明啊。”
之前滴滴打车A轮融资是金沙江创投300万美元，B轮融资：腾讯1500万美元，C轮融资：中信6000万美元和腾讯3000万美元。
现在D轮融资，想要融到更多的资金，最好的办法就是让参加融资的资本方相互竞争。
现在这份名单，就是这个作用。
“姜总，这也是一件好事。”
聂星辰说道：“相对于其他的资本，我们星辰投资才初出茅庐，和他们相比竞争力低了不少，如果能够在这次滴滴打车的D轮融资中能够成功，也算是打响了我们的名气。”
在姜辰和伍十一回来之前，聂星辰已经研究过这些资本方了。
就淡马锡、DST、腾讯，软银等几家资本方，都让聂星辰有窒息的感觉。
“那你们觉得这次D轮融资的估值是多少？”姜辰开口问道。
聂星辰问道：“按照滴滴打车之前的情况来看，这次融资的估值大概有三十亿美金。”
“姜总，我觉得聂秘书说的没错。”余青青也说道：“虽然滴滴打车已经超过了快的，但在市场占有率上，滴滴打车现在和快的算得上是平分秋色。”

“快的？”
姜辰眉头一挑。
在前世，他记得滴滴打车在D轮融资后，不到两个月滴滴打车就和快的进行了战略合并，同时，在滴滴打车D轮融资后不久，快的打车完成新一轮总额6亿美元的融资，由软银集团领投，阿里巴巴集团以及老虎环球基金也参与了此次投资。
现在在影视融合世界，也许和前世不太一样，但未必就不能以此为参考。
“这样吧，聂秘书，你这两天收集一下快的的资料。”姜辰想了想，说道：“另外，想办法接触一下快的的股东，看看有没有可能从他们手中购买一点快的的股份。”
“好的。”聂星辰点点头。
两天后，姜辰带着三女来到了香格里拉酒店的二十楼。
滴滴打车的D轮融资就是在这里举行的。
姜辰他们到的时候，已经有很多的资本方已经来了。
因为这些资本方没人认识的，所以，姜辰他们在到了之后，就找了个角落坐下。
“姜总，那边是淡马锡的代表。那边是DST的代表，那边是腾讯……他们旁边的是软银的代表……”聂星辰之前调查过相关资料，所以在坐下之后，她就向姜辰介绍了起来。
有名有姓的像红杉资本的沈南鹏。
IDG资本的的熊老总。
content_en:
"It's still early now, let's find a scenic spot to visit."
After leaving Anjia Tianxia Store, Jiang Chen said to Wu Shiyi.
"Which scenic spot does Mr. Jiang want to go to?" Wu Shiyi asked as he started the car.
"Whatever."
Jiang Chen had never been to Yanjing in his previous life. Although he was very curious about Yanjing, he didn't know where to go.
Wu Shiyi turned on the navigation and took Jiang Chen to a nearby scenic spot.
After wandering around the scenic spot for two hours, Jiang Chen returned to the hotel.
"Mr. Jiang, this is a document sent by Didi Dache. It lists the capital that will participate in financing the day after tomorrow." Nie Xingchen handed a piece of information to Jiang Chen.
"Is it from Mr. Cheng?"
Jiang Chen was stunned for a moment, then laughed: "It seems that Mr. Cheng's plan is very smart."
Didi Dache's previous Series A financing was US$3 million from Jinshajiang Venture Capital, Series B financing: US$15 million from Tencent, and Series C financing: US$60 million from CITIC and US$30 million from Tencent.
Now in the D round of financing, if you want to raise more funds, the best way is to let the capital parties participating in the financing compete with each other.
The current list serves this purpose.
"Mr. Jiang, this is also a good thing."
Nie Xingchen said: "Compared to other capitals, we at Xingchen Investment are just in their infancy and are much less competitive than them. If we can succeed in this D-round financing of Didi Dache, it will be considered a good start for us."
Before Jiang Chen and Wu Shiyi came back, Nie Xingchen had already studied these capital methods.
Temasek, DST, Tencent, SoftBank and other capital investors all made Nie Xingchen feel suffocated.
"Then what do you think the valuation of this D round of financing is?" Jiang Chen asked.
Nie Xingchen asked: "Based on Didi Taxi's previous situation, the valuation of this financing is approximately US$3 billion."
"Mr. Jiang, I think Secretary Nie is right." Yu Qingqing also said: "Although Didi Dache has surpassed Kuaidi, in terms of market share, Didi Dache is now evenly matched with Kuaidi."
"Quick?"
Jiang Chen raised his eyebrows.
In his previous life, he remembered that Didi Dache carried out a strategic merger with Kuaidi in less than two months after Didi Dache’s D round of financing. At the same time, shortly after Didi Dache’s D round of financing, Kuaidi Dache completed a new round of financing totaling US$600 million, led by SoftBank Group, with Alibaba Group and Tiger Global Management also participating in the investment.
Now in the world of film and television integration, it may be different from the previous life, but it doesn’t necessarily mean we can’t use it as a reference.
"Let's do this, Secretary Nie, collect information about Kuaidu in the past two days." Jiang Chen thought for a while and said, "In addition, find a way to contact Kuaidu's shareholders to see if it is possible to buy some Kuaidu shares from them."
"Okay." Nie Xingchen nodded.
Two days later, Jiang Chen took the three girls to the twentieth floor of the Shangri-La Hotel.
Didi Taxi’s D-round financing was held here.
When Jiang Chen and the others arrived, many capital parties had already arrived.
Because no one from the capital side knew them, Jiang Chen and the others found a corner to sit down after they arrived.
"Mr. Jiang, over there is the representative of Temasek. Over there is the representative of DST, over there is the representative of Tencent... Next to them is the representative of SoftBank..." Nie Xingchen had investigated the relevant information before, so after sitting down, she introduced it to Jiang Chen.
The famous ones are like Shen Nanpeng of Sequoia Capital.
Mr. Xiong of IDG Capital.
